(It was also a good chance to practice sourcing and adopting a mature utility into my personal pipeline.) I found a few enterprise solutions, but I decided on Promptfoo, an open source solution. It was very fast to set up and start with, I feel like I really optimized the outcome with tons of capabilities and bare minimum time spent. I look forward to trying advanced cases! Here's the Github if you want to see it: https://lnkd.in/g-8q-44t My search has me curious, what solutions are the most widely used? How do you manage your evals... do you use Promptfoo, another product, an in-house custom solution, or something simpler? #ProductManagement #AI #Promptfoo #evals
